span.p:
Memory per entry:
- Key pointer: 8 bytes (64-bit)
- Value pointer: 8 bytes
- Prev pointer: 8 bytes
- Next pointer: 8 bytes
- Hash table entry: 8 bytes
- Size/length: 4 bytes
- Last access time: 8 bytes (optional)
Total overhead: ~52 bytes per entry
